translationRepairs: When Quyu died, his son Yiyi was established.
When Quyu died, his son Yiwu was established.
夷吾 is Yiwu; Yiyi matches neither the characters nor the unit’s own literal rendering Yiwu.
When Yiyi died, his son Qinchu was established.
When Yiwu died, his son Qinchu was established.
The same 夷吾 is again spelled Yiyi; the successor sentence must use Yiwu.
From Huo below, no criticism there.
From Kuai and below, there was no criticism.
鄶 is Kuai, the odes-state already so named in the idiomatic line; Huo is a different graph.
Saw dance elephant trunk, south flute, said: 'Beautiful indeed, still have emotion.'
Saw dance Xiangshuo, Nanyue, said: 'Beautiful indeed, still have emotion.'
象箾 and 南籥 are dance names, not an elephant trunk and a south flute, but the proposal also idiomatizes a literal line and needlessly swaps emotion for feeling.
Saw dance Zhao trunk, said: 'Virtue utmost indeed, great indeed, like heaven no not cover also, like earth no not carry also, although very flourishing virtue, nothing add.
Saw dance Zhaoshuo, said: 'Virtue utmost indeed, great indeed, like heaven no not cover also, like earth no not carry also, although very flourishing virtue, nothing add.
招箾 is the dance Zhaoshuo, not a Zhao trunk; the rest of the calque already tracks 無不燾 / 無不載 and should not be rewritten as idiomatic English.
The ruler is extravagant and has many favorites, and the grandees are all rich. The government will end up in the hands of the three families.
The ruler is extravagant and has many good men, and the grandees are all rich. The government will end up in the hands of the three families.
多良 is many worthy/good men; favorites would be 嬖, which the Chinese does not have.
He often thought: The four brothers of my father should have passed the throne to Jizi.
He often thought: My father and his brothers, four men, should have passed the throne to Jizi.
吾父兄弟四人 is Guang’s father plus his brothers as a set of four, confirmed by the next unit that his father was established first; “four brothers of my father” wrongly excludes him.
In the sixth year, Chu sent Zichang and Nang Wa to attack Wu.
In the sixth year, Chu sent Zichang Nang Wa to attack Wu.
子常囊瓦 is one Chu commander, courtesy name 子常 plus personal name 囊瓦, not two men joined by and.
Chu feared and left Ying moved to Rui.
Chu feared and left Ying, moved to Ruo.
鄀 is Ruo; Rui transcribes a different place-name.
Di Xiang consort Hou Zhen just pregnant, fled to You Ren and gave birth Shao Kang.
Di Xiang consort Hou Min just pregnant, fled to You Ren and gave birth Shao Kang.
后緡 is Hou Min; Zhen is a misreading of 緡.
Wu king heard this, greatly angered, granted Zixu the Lou sword to die.
Wu king heard this, greatly angered, granted Zixu the Zhulou sword to die.
屬鏤 is the full sword name, so Lou is incomplete, but this chapter’s idiomatic line and claims already use Zhulou rather than Shulou.
The king of Wu said: “I am old and lonely, and I can no longer serve the lord king.
The king of Wu said: “I am old, and I can no longer serve the lord king.
孤 is the royal first person; 孤老矣 says he is old and does not claim loneliness.
Wu king said: 'I am orphaned and old, cannot serve lord king also.
Wu king said: 'I am old, cannot serve lord king also.
孤 is royal self-reference, so “orphaned” invents a biography, but the proposed line also drops the calque and over-smooths the rest of the literal field.
